newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian average lending rate down to 10.4 percent.
newsitem.headline: Croatian average lending rate down to 10.4 percent.

text.p: Croatia's average lending rate, lowered by a weaker demand for kuna funds, edged down ten basis points to 10.4 percent on Tuesday.
Total settlements were down to 36.3 million kuna leaving a surplus of 26.7 million on the supply side.
Most loans were call money, at a rate of nine percent, 75 basis points down on Monday.
Overnight trade reached 130.1 million kuna, of which 99 million went to one bank with shortfalls and the rest to the mandatory reserves.
The Central bank said its kuna midrates for Wednesday firmed to 5.3945 to the dollar and to 3.5666 against the German mark. -- Metka Jelenc, Zagreb Newsroom. 385-1-4557075
